title: Are Polysemantic Neurons Disproportionately Located in Safety-Critical Layers?
original_idea: Measure polysemanticity proxy (entropy of max-activating token distribution) for each MLP neuron in GPT-2 Small. Compare mean polysemanticity between safety-relevant and control layers using Mann-Whitney U test.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Interesting question but same issue as gen-1653: GPT-2 Small lacks clear safety-relevant layers since it has no RLHF training. The 'safety-critical' designation is weak.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Entropy computation is simple, but identifying safety-relevant layers in GPT-2 Small via ablation on refusal prompts is problematic. Statistical test is standard.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear metric (entropy per neuron per layer), clear statistical test (Mann-Whitney U). Weakened by ambiguity in safety-relevant layer identification.
